values.note: 'Sites are not reservable. Sites are on a first come, first serve basis.' Very busy during trout stocking (spring through June, and September-October), when campers often outnumber sites; the Forest Service points overflow to Bishop Knob Campground. Check-out 2 p.m. One wheeled camping unit, 8 people and 2 vehicles per single site. Fees can be paid on recreation.gov (first-come pay page).

Sites are on a first come, first serve basis.', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days.', 'Check-out time is 2:00 p.m.', 'Single site limit is one wheeled camping unit only ... no more than 8 people; no more than 2 vehicles') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10351700/rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-04-20 to 2026-10-31), read 2026-10-21

values.note: recreation.gov's 2026 first-come rate table: single site $15, walk-in $15, double site $30. The Forest Service page still lists single $10 and double $20 (undated).

values.note: 28 single and 2 double sites in two loops, each with a gravel parking spur; sites 23 and 24 are walk-in. 'Most sites can accommodate a 40' trailer'.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/cranberry-campground ('Campground features 28 single campsites and two double sites in two loops', 'Walk-in Single (#23 & #24)', 'Size Restrictions: Most sites can accommodate a 40' trailer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two hand pumps and accessible vault toilets. The Forest Service page contradicts itself on a dump station ('No dump station is available at campground' vs 'Cranberry Campground has its own dump station that is donation based'); recreation.gov lists one. Private dump stations and water fill in Richwood.

summary: Booking corrected: first-come only (own value now overrides the inherited recreation.gov reservable/platform/window), 14-day max. Fees $15-30 confirmed on recreation.gov's 2026 table, with the Forest Service page's older $10/$20 noted. No hookups, 30 sites, most to 40 ft, vault toilets and hand-pump water written. Season not stated (rate season only).
flags: Entry has no phone. The Forest Service page and recreation.gov give the Gauley District Richwood office, (304) 846-2695.

Fee conflict between official pages: recreation.gov's 2026 first-come rate table charges $15 single / $30 double, while the Forest Service page lists $10 single / $20 double (undated). Recorded the recreation.gov figure.
Fees nightly_high 30 (an earlier human check) is the double-site price; a single site is $15 throughout. Left as recorded; a human may want high 15.

The entry's website includes https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/239759 (a point-of-interest page); the campground's own recreation.gov page is https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10351700.

recreation.gov/Forest Service prose says 'adjacent to the Cranberry River'; the entry is 'not waterfront' on AWH's firsthand note ('across the road ... Sites are not waterfront'). Marketing prose only, so no re-audit is needed unless wanted.
